comments.body:
RP-06 approved design. Replace the partially independent plan-review/code-review discovery authorities with: CriteriaSnapshot -> gate-owned strategy -> DiscoveryStagePlan -> shared executor -> DiscoveryStageResult -> gate-owned verdict policy. The immutable repository-bound snapshot contains effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, routing, prompts, posture, applicability, provenance, and a deterministic digest. Gate strategies retain applicability, topology, scheduling, context, and verdict ownership. The executor owns typed per-unit outcomes, usage, budget enforcement, cancellation, and success-only resume mechanics; it does not retry provider turns, truncate authoritative inputs, decide applicability, or render verdicts. Preserve code-review base reviewer, sequential schedule, one-hop Round B, authored YAML/BPMN topology, and narrow output. Preserve plan-review chunking, concurrency, cache warming, containers/prerequisites, cancellation, and checkpoint behavior while moving to a digest-complete success-only journal namespace.

Approved partial-failure semantics: continue independent units after RP-01 exhausts an operation; retain successful results; record dependency-blocked skips with provenance; return unsigned INDETERMINATE when blocking-capable coverage is missing unless an actual blocking result takes precedence. Advisory-only gaps may still pass. Systemic configuration, cancellation, deterministic-floor, and whole-tier failures remain fail-safe. Store a versioned typed discovery trace for retry, audit, and diagnostics, but do not expose trace/debug details, raw prompts, ticket content, provider payloads, or secrets in review or review-status responses. Those responses remain narrow end-result contracts.

Approved review-plan --retry semantics: this is an explicit override with a fresh per-invocation attempt budget. Only the literal latest completed INDETERMINATE review with retryable missing calls is eligible. Reuse content-identical successful pass/block units and retry only missing work; budget-shed units remain missing. Rerun deterministic decision, assembly, and signing eligibility over the combined result. Refuse before any model call for PASS/BLOCK, non-retryable indeterminate, missing/legacy/corrupt/stale/digest-mismatched lineage, or changed material/policy/model/topology/context/dependencies. Never silently fall through to a full review. --retry conflicts with --force, --status, and --check; --no-sign remains compatible. Persist cumulative usage for audit only; it never caps a later explicit retry. Canonical documentation is required in native review-plan --help, generated docs/cli-reference.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, and docs/exit-codes.md, including a generated-help drift guard.
